name: panel
description: A local web page with a card for every Claude Code session on this machine: whether it waits for you, what it needs, what it is doing, with a summary from claude -p every few minutes and a refresh button.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Register /panel, start the page server and listen for answers. Off, the mod does nothing; a server already running keeps running.

port.title: Port
port.description: The page listens on 127.0.0.1 at this port

model.title: Summary model
model.description: The model claude -p uses to write each card

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: A session whose transcript changed gets a new summary this often. A session that goes idle after a turn gets one right away

autostart.title: Start the page
autostart.description: Start the page server when a session starts and it is not running. Off when a service manager such as systemd runs it

answers.title: Answers from the page
answers.description: Let the page send text to this session as your prompt. Off, the page shows this session's options greyed out and no reply field.
